note: The session's shared web-search allowance was already spent when this part began, so it went by fetching official pages directly. The main source is the Kentucky State Board of Elections' official 2022 general election recap sheets (precinct by precinct; county totals here are this agent's sums of the precinct rows, and each winner's margin is wide enough that a missed precinct would not change it, except Hardin County's 2nd Magisterial District, 1,342 to 1,300). Recaps for Anderson, Bourbon, Carter, Fleming, Grant, Lee, Marshall, Mercer, Pendleton, Robertson, Spencer, Greenup, Nelson and Union counties are scans with no text layer, so the candidates there are left blank. Several county sites did not resolve or carry no names (Anderson, Bullitt, Crittenden, Fleming, Lyon, Marshall, Hardin, Lyndon). Pages read that do not name the candidate: Carter County's officials page names Mike Johnston as county clerk (not Debbie Johnston); Lee County's names Steve Mays, Jr. as judge/executive (not John Fike); Spencer County's names Danny Hilbert as coroner (not Bill Wood); Erlanger's council page does not list Corine Pitts; Hopkinsville's 2025-2026 council roster does not list Markeeta Oldham Wilkerson. Johnny Ray Turner (House 95): Wikipedia's 2026 Kentucky House election article calls him the former 29th District senator, but without a citation, and no cited or official page tying the 2026 candidate to the former senator could be reached (WYMT did not resolve for WebFetch), so nothing is recorded for him. Steve Bratcher is a sitting legislator with a record page; no campaign website was found and the party pages list him without endorsing (already in ky_endorsements.json). Several candidates found here hold the office they seek today while our record's incumbent flag is 0; the county clerks' filing lists do not mark local incumbents, so this is noted rather than filed as a review item. Kevin R Kirby won Warren County Coroner in 2022 as a Democrat and is on the 2026 list as a Republican; both are recorded as the record shows them. While exploring, the Revenue Cabinet's PVA directory printed two PVA office e-mail cells to this agent's output and Carter County's page an office street address; none of it is stored here.
